name: Zeke Campbell
source:
Zeke is a second-year wide receiver in [url=/c148299]Underwood[/url]’s system who came on hot near the end of previous last season. A smart route runner who attacks the middle of the field, complimenting the rough play style of [url=/c148303]Sammy[/url] and the danger of [url=/c148374]Jakeem[/url] over the top.
